The covariate-adjusted ATT is about 4.14. I fit an outcome regression on the control group only, using x1–x25. I then predicted what each treated child's score would have been without treatment and averaged the difference from their actual scores.

The unadjusted difference in means is 4.23. A single OLS regression on treatment plus all covariates gives 4.18, so the estimate is stable across approaches. I chose the control-only imputation because it targets the effect on the treated directly.

ANSWER: 4.14
